'''Kuni''' is a [[Malayo-Polynesian languages]] of the central southern coast of the [[Papuan Peninsula]] in [[Papua New Guinea]].

== External links ==
* A number of collections in [[Paradisec]] [http://catalog.paradisec.org.au/collections/search?language_code=kue include Kuni materials]
